title_en: Earth's Core Hotter Than Sun's Surface
reveal_en: Despite being deep inside our planet, the Earth's inner core boasts temperatures soaring to nearly 6,000 degrees Celsius. This makes it as hot as, or even hotter than, the surface of the Sun.
reveal_zh: 尽管深埋地心，地球内核的温度却高达近6000摄氏度。它与太阳表面一样热，甚至更热。
meaning_en: This internal inferno reminds us of the immense, hidden power shaping our planet from within.
meaning_zh: 这个内部熔炉提醒我们，地球内部蕴藏着塑造我们星球的巨大能量。

visual.motion: Molten core pulsating with heat shimmers.
